title: 图片快照读取失败与权限降级 VM fake 回归

testBoundary.productionCode: copySelectedItem extracted from src/main/main.ts and executed in a Node VM
testBoundary.readFailure: Fake NativeContentProvider.snapshot rejects with content_item_not_found, a production snapshot lookup error

scenarios.copySideEffectMeaning: The one helper clipboard commit is the intended copy-only degradation; this scenario does not have zero total effects.

limitations: The read failure is injected at the provider snapshot boundary; no real file, OS clipboard, or NativeContentProvider read was performed.
The permission denial is a fake AllowSetForegroundWindow result; it does not exercise a real higher-integrity target or UIPI behavior.
These regressions cover the stated fake boundaries only; I04 queue/cache/capacity edges, cancellation under a real CPU-bound decode, real platform permissions, and full T04 acceptance remain open.
